purpose: private authored activity pilot; not learner-facing

activities.cueEnglish: Find when this Paris café asks the friends to pay.
activities.modelFrench: Le serveur dit qu’ils peuvent payer au comptoir après avoir commandé.
activities.modelEnglish: The server says they can pay at the counter after ordering.

activities.cueEnglish: Recall the French word for a receipt.
activities.modelFrench: le ticket de caisse
activities.modelEnglish: the receipt

activities.cueEnglish: Listen for the question about whether the stool is reserved.
activities.modelFrench: Pouvons-nous nous asseoir ici, ou cette place est-elle réservée ?
activities.modelEnglish: Could we sit here, or is this seat reserved?

activities.cueEnglish: Type the question asking when to pay at this café.
activities.modelFrench: Quand paie-t-on dans ce café ?
activities.modelEnglish: When do we pay at this café?

activities.cueEnglish: Order an espresso and a croissant politely.
activities.modelFrench: Je voudrais un expresso et un croissant, s’il vous plaît.
activities.modelEnglish: I would like an espresso and a croissant, please.

activities.cueEnglish: Write Thiago's step-by-step summary of their café visit.
activities.modelFrench: Thiago dit qu’ils ont lu l’ardoise, vérifié la place, commandé et payé.
activities.modelEnglish: Thiago says they read the menu, checked the seat, ordered and paid.

activities.cueEnglish: Find which kind of loaf the baker says the house bread is today.
activities.modelFrench: La boulangère explique qu’aujourd’hui, c’est une miche.
activities.modelEnglish: The baker explains that today it is a round loaf.

activities.cueEnglish: Recall the French word for a bread crust.
activities.modelFrench: la croûte
activities.modelEnglish: the crust

activities.cueEnglish: Listen for the question about ham and preparation when avoiding pork.
activities.modelFrench: Si tu évites le porc, renseigne-toi sur le jambon et la préparation.
activities.modelEnglish: If you avoid pork, ask about the ham and preparation.

activities.cueEnglish: Type the question comparing the house bread with a baguette.
activities.modelFrench: Le pain maison est-il une baguette ou une miche ?
activities.modelEnglish: Is the house bread a baguette or a round loaf?

activities.cueEnglish: Order a small bread with jam.
activities.modelFrench: Je voudrais un petit pain avec de la confiture, s’il vous plaît.
activities.modelEnglish: I would like a small bread with jam, please.

activities.cueEnglish: Write Camille's summary of the four bread-order choices.
activities.modelFrench: Camille résume les choix : le pain, la portion, la garniture et la préparation.
activities.modelEnglish: Camille summarizes the choices: bread, portion, topping and preparation.

activities.cueEnglish: Find where the server places Sofie's hot chocolate.
activities.modelFrench: Le serveur répète la commande et pose la tasse sur le comptoir.
activities.modelEnglish: The server repeats the order and places the cup on the counter.

activities.cueEnglish: Recall the French word for the rim of a mug.
activities.modelFrench: le bord
activities.modelEnglish: the rim

activities.cueEnglish: Listen for Sofie's polite hot-chocolate request.
activities.modelFrench: Bonjour, pourrais-je avoir un chocolat chaud ?
activities.modelEnglish: Hello, may I have a hot chocolate?

activities.cueEnglish: Type the instruction to ask the price before paying.
activities.modelFrench: Demande le prix avant de payer.
activities.modelEnglish: Ask the price before you pay.

activities.cueEnglish: Ask the server to put the cup on the counter.
activities.modelFrench: Demande au serveur de poser la tasse sur le comptoir.
activities.modelEnglish: Ask the server to put the cup on the counter.

activities.cueEnglish: Write how Sofie repeats her order at the end.
activities.modelFrench: Sofie répète sa commande et dit qu’elle attendra avant de boire.
activities.modelEnglish: Sofie repeats her order and says she will wait before drinking.

activities.cueEnglish: Find why the printed allergen chart may be out of date.
activities.modelFrench: Rémi remarque que la date précède le dernier changement de fournisseur.
activities.modelEnglish: Rémi notices that the date is older than the latest supplier change.

activities.cueEnglish: Recall the French term for sesame.
activities.modelFrench: le sésame
activities.modelEnglish: sesame

activities.cueEnglish: Listen for the direct sesame-allergy statement.
activities.modelFrench: Mon partenaire est allergique au sésame.
activities.modelEnglish: My partner has a sesame allergy.

activities.cueEnglish: Type the request for the current supplier label.
activities.modelFrench: Pourriez-vous nous montrer l’étiquette actuelle du fournisseur ?
activities.modelEnglish: Could you show us the current supplier label?

activities.cueEnglish: Ask how the bread is prepared and whether equipment is shared.
activities.modelFrench: Comment ce produit est-il préparé, et le matériel est-il partagé ?
activities.modelEnglish: How is this item prepared, and is equipment shared?

activities.cueEnglish: Write what the staff cannot confirm about preparation and cross-contact.
activities.modelFrench: Pour l’autre produit, le personnel ne peut pas confirmer la préparation ni le contact croisé possible.
activities.modelEnglish: For the other item, staff cannot confirm the preparation or possible cross-contact.

activities.cueEnglish: Find the reason the breakfast room is closed.
activities.modelFrench: Maude dit que des travaux ont commencé de façon imprévue ce matin-là.
activities.modelEnglish: Maude says that repairs began unexpectedly that morning.

activities.cueEnglish: Recall the French word for a voucher.
activities.modelFrench: le bon
activities.modelEnglish: the voucher

activities.cueEnglish: Listen for Daniel's statement that breakfast was included.
activities.modelFrench: Ma confirmation indique que le petit-déjeuner est compris.
activities.modelEnglish: My confirmation says breakfast is included.

activities.cueEnglish: Type the request to check with management.
activities.modelFrench: Pourriez-vous vérifier auprès de la direction, s’il vous plaît ?
activities.modelEnglish: Could you check with management, please?

activities.cueEnglish: Ask how the hotel would handle the bill if there is no alternative.
activities.modelFrench: Sinon, pourriez-vous m’expliquer les possibilités de facturation ?
activities.modelEnglish: If not, could you explain the billing options?

activities.cueEnglish: Write what Maude does not promise before checking the terms.
activities.modelFrench: Elle ne promet ni bon, ni réduction, ni remboursement.
activities.modelEnglish: She does not promise a voucher, discount or refund.

activities.cueEnglish: Find the three plant drinks the server lists.
activities.modelFrench: Il cite les boissons au soja, à l’amande et à la noix de coco comme solutions possibles.
activities.modelEnglish: He lists soy, almond and coconut drinks as possible alternatives.

activities.cueEnglish: Recall the French term for lactose-free milk.
activities.modelFrench: le lait sans lactose
activities.modelEnglish: the lactose-free milk

activities.cueEnglish: Listen for Hannah's direct vegan ingredient and preparation question.
activities.modelFrench: Hannah est végétalienne ; pourriez-vous vérifier les ingrédients et la préparation ?
activities.modelEnglish: Hannah is vegan; could you check the ingredients and preparation?

activities.cueEnglish: Type the question about butter and dairy in the croissants.
activities.modelFrench: Les croissants au beurre contiennent des produits laitiers, n’est-ce pas ?
activities.modelEnglish: The butter croissants contain dairy, correct?

activities.cueEnglish: Ask when the oat-drink delivery is expected.
activities.modelFrench: Quand la livraison de boisson à l’avoine est-elle prévue ?
activities.modelEnglish: When is the oat-drink delivery expected?

activities.cueEnglish: Write what Hannah and Dev choose while preparation details remain unclear.
activities.modelFrench: Hannah et Dev choisissent d’attendre ou d’aller dans un autre café plutôt que de supposer qu’une boisson leur convient.
activities.modelEnglish: Hannah and Dev choose to wait or use another café rather than assume a drink is suitable.

activities.cueEnglish: Find how Emma and the worker recount the unpaid items.
activities.modelFrench: La personne reprend les articles non payés avec Emma, un par un.
activities.modelEnglish: The worker recounts the unpaid items with Emma, one by one.

activities.cueEnglish: Recall the French term for the outstanding balance.
activities.modelFrench: le solde à payer
activities.modelEnglish: the outstanding balance

activities.cueEnglish: Listen for the group's toast and coffee quantities.
activities.modelFrench: Nous avons commandé sept tartines et neuf petits cafés noirs.
activities.modelEnglish: We ordered seven toasts and nine small black coffees.

activities.cueEnglish: Type the request to confirm the remaining balance.
activities.modelFrench: Pourriez-vous confirmer le solde à payer, s’il vous plaît ?
activities.modelEnglish: Could you confirm the remaining balance, please?

activities.cueEnglish: Ask whether bank transfer is accepted or only cash.
activities.modelFrench: Puis-je payer par virement ou seulement en espèces ?
activities.modelEnglish: Can I pay by bank transfer or only in cash?

activities.cueEnglish: Write what Emma keeps after paying the confirmed balance.
activities.modelFrench: Emma règle le solde confirmé et garde la preuve de paiement.
activities.modelEnglish: Emma pays the confirmed balance and keeps the proof of payment.

activities.cueEnglish: Find what the current label says about tree nuts and cross-contact.
activities.modelFrench: Elle indique des fruits à coque et un avertissement sur un possible contact croisé.
activities.modelEnglish: It lists tree nuts and a possible cross-contact warning.

activities.cueEnglish: Recall the French term for a serious allergy.
activities.modelFrench: l’allergie grave
activities.modelEnglish: the serious allergy

activities.cueEnglish: Listen for the direct statement about a serious tree-nut allergy.
activities.modelFrench: Mon ami a une allergie grave aux fruits à coque.
activities.modelEnglish: My friend has a serious tree-nut allergy.

activities.cueEnglish: Type the question about a packaged product with a current label.
activities.modelFrench: Avez-vous un produit emballé avec une étiquette d’allergènes à jour ?
activities.modelEnglish: Do you have a packaged product with a current allergen label?

activities.cueEnglish: Ask the baker not to scrape the almonds off the pastry.
activities.modelFrench: Merci, mais n’enlevez pas simplement les amandes, s’il vous plaît.
activities.modelEnglish: Thank you, but please do not scrape off the almonds.

activities.cueEnglish: Write Kenji's decision about ordering food from this counter.
activities.modelFrench: Kenji décide de ne pas commander de nourriture à ce comptoir.
activities.modelEnglish: Kenji decides not to order food from this counter.

activities.cueEnglish: Find what Daniel cannot read on the menu board from the register.
activities.modelFrench: Depuis la caisse, il n’arrive pas à lire clairement les petits prix.
activities.modelEnglish: From the register, he cannot read the small prices clearly.

activities.cueEnglish: Recall the French word for chalk.
activities.modelFrench: la craie
activities.modelEnglish: the chalk

activities.cueEnglish: Listen for Daniel's honest opinion about the coffee temperature.
activities.modelFrench: Si vous voulez mon avis sincère, le café était un peu tiède.
activities.modelEnglish: If you would like my honest opinion, the coffee arrived a little cool.

activities.cueEnglish: Type the suggestion to write prices in larger letters.
activities.modelFrench: Ce serait plus clair d’écrire les prix en plus gros.
activities.modelEnglish: It would help to write prices in larger letters.

activities.cueEnglish: Suggest warming the cups before serving.
activities.modelFrench: Je vous conseillerais de réchauffer les tasses avant de servir.
activities.modelEnglish: I would suggest warming the cups before serving.

activities.cueEnglish: Write Daniel's closing wish for the new café.
activities.modelFrench: Avant de partir, il souhaite à Camille beaucoup de succès avec son café.
activities.modelEnglish: Before leaving, he wishes Camille success with the café.

activities.cueEnglish: Find the confirmed driver pickup time in the message.
activities.modelFrench: Le message indique que le chauffeur arrivera à la maison d’hôtes à sept heures et demie.
activities.modelEnglish: The message says the driver will arrive at the guesthouse at seven thirty.

activities.cueEnglish: Recall the French term for altitude sickness.
activities.modelFrench: le mal aigu des montagnes
activities.modelEnglish: altitude sickness

activities.cueEnglish: Listen for Lars mentioning altitude sickness before the outing.
activities.modelFrench: Lars dit qu’il n’y aura peut-être pas assez de temps avant la prise en charge réservée ; il évoque aussi le mal aigu des montagnes avant la sortie en montagne.
activities.modelEnglish: Lars says that there may not be enough time before the booked pickup; he also mentions altitude sickness before the mountain outing.

activities.cueEnglish: Type the question asking to check the pickup time.
activities.modelFrench: Pourrions-nous vérifier l’heure de prise en charge ?
activities.modelEnglish: Could we check the pickup time?

activities.cueEnglish: Ask what breakfast plan would work for everyone.
activities.modelFrench: Qu’est-ce qui conviendrait à tout le monde ?
activities.modelEnglish: What would work for everyone?

activities.cueEnglish: Write the agreed breakfast plan.
activities.modelFrench: Nous sommes donc d’accord pour prendre le petit-déjeuner ici.
activities.modelEnglish: So we agree on breakfast here.
